name: Seri Bunga
bio: Bunga unloads at the royal landing because Mahmud’s household claims her labor. She swaps news with a boatman to find where her brother has been sent and asks a warehouse keeper to witness the transfer.
notes: inference: Thomaz identifies cash-purchased belati among the ruler’s dockworkers, not the entire unloading workforce (port-labour.md §§1, 3; Thomaz p. 75)
gameplay: Bunga, her brother and the witness are fictional. Her story is about separation and who will help her, not buying unloading capacity (port-labour.md §4)
